$comment: Story 8.1 (AD-25, D37, NFR-5): every production resource a dev configuration must never point at. The live system on main runs on the Windows VPS in C:/Project/mmo; the new production follows the deployment table of diagrams/c4-deployment.md. A value the owner learns later (the production Zalo account) is added here.
